title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten current UAB library-based study environments, selected for their documented quiet, collaboration, reservation, or accessibility features.

cards.entity_name: Mervyn H. Sterne Library First-Floor Collaborative Study Space
cards.title: Sterne First-Floor Collaborative Study Space
cards.subtitle: Mervyn H. Sterne Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up for a partner session on the first floor, where UAB designates group study rooms, tables, and computer stations for collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: A library-floor option for quietly collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Libraries permits group study on first-floor study rooms, tables, and computer stations when it does not disturb others.
cards.access_notes: Keep voices reasonable; close study-room doors because rooms are not soundproof.

cards.entity_name: Mervyn H. Sterne Library Third-Floor Quiet Zone
cards.title: Sterne Third-Floor Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Mervyn H. Sterne Library, third floor
cards.notes: Bring quiet, independent work to the third floor and use headphones for any audio; the whole floor remains designated as a quiet zone.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-library floor for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB states that the entire third floor of Sterne Library remains a quiet zone.
cards.source_title: Changes to Sterne Library's Quiet Zone
cards.access_notes: Minimize noise; the library’s room policy identifies the third floor as a quiet study area.

cards.entity_name: Mervyn H. Sterne Library Single Study Rooms
cards.title: Sterne Single Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mervyn H. Sterne Library, third floor
cards.notes: Reserve a one-person room through the library portal, then check in at the HUB Service Desk; individual rooms can be booked for four hours.
cards.short_summary: Reservable, single-user rooms on Sterne’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Sterne has 61 single rooms on the third floor; individual rooms may be booked for four hours with one renewal option.
cards.access_notes: Available to currently enrolled UAB students, postdocs, faculty, and staff with a UAB ONE Card; check in at the HUB Desk.

cards.entity_name: Mervyn H. Sterne Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Sterne Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mervyn H. Sterne Library, first and third floors
cards.notes: Book a group room for a planned working session and arrive together at the HUB Desk; a group needs at least two people at checkout.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms with a documented check-in process.
cards.evidence_claim: Sterne has 13 group study rooms, with nine on the first floor and four on the third floor.
cards.access_notes: Book online the same day or up to two weeks ahead; group-study bookings run three hours and require two group members at checkout.

cards.entity_name: Mervyn H. Sterne Library Study Carrels
cards.title: Sterne Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Mervyn H. Sterne Library, third-floor quiet area
cards.notes: Use a carrel when you need a defined solo workspace; keep audio in headphones and maintain the minimal-noise expectations of the quiet area.
cards.short_summary: Individual carrels in Sterne’s quiet-study setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Sterne offers daily and long-term study carrels; carrels are limited to one person and the third floor is a quiet zone.
cards.access_notes: A valid UAB ID is required. Long-term carrels are for faculty, graduate students, and students with disabilities, subject to availability and application.

cards.title: SL 174 Collaborative Learning Room
cards.subtitle: Mervyn H. Sterne Library, Room SL 174
cards.notes: Request SL 174 for a larger collaborative session when eligible; its nine four-seat pods support table-based group work rather than silent solo study.
cards.short_summary: A reservable room with nine four-person learning pods.
cards.evidence_claim: SL 174 has nine pods of four seats for collaborative learning and may be used for collaborative group study during final exams.
cards.access_notes: Request through the library’s SL 174 reservation form; library instruction and Writing Center classes have priority.

cards.title: Sterne 385 Sensory Room
cards.subtitle: Mervyn H. Sterne Library, third floor
cards.notes: Reserve one of the two seats when a low-stimulation reset supports your work; return sensory items and furniture to their original places before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, calm setting with sensory-friendly equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Sterne 385 is a reservable room for up to two users and includes adjustable lighting, a sound machine, meditation prompts, fidget tools, and weighted lap pads.
cards.source_title: See inside Sterne's new sensory room
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; it accommodates two independently reserved users and is intended as a calm, low-stimulation space rather than a traditional study room.

cards.entity_name: Lister Hill Library First-Floor Study Rooms
cards.title: Lister Hill First-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lister Hill Library of the Health Sciences, first floor
cards.notes: Reserve a single or group room for a health-sciences study session, then check in at the HUB Service Desk before using the reserved space.
cards.short_summary: First-floor rooms for individual or collaborative sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Lister Hill’s first floor has both group and single-person study rooms available for booking.
cards.source_title: Use this new interactive map feature to book study rooms, seminar rooms and other UAB Libraries spaces
cards.access_notes: For UAB community members; reserve online the same day or up to two weeks ahead, and check in at the Lister Hill HUB Desk.

cards.entity_name: Lister Hill Library Second-Floor Quiet Area
cards.title: Lister Hill Second-Floor Quiet Area
cards.subtitle: Lister Hill Library of the Health Sciences, second floor
cards.notes: Choose the second-floor quiet area for reading or concentrated drafting, and keep phone conversations outside or in a first-floor lobby area.
cards.short_summary: An open, quiet second-floor library environment.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB’s undergraduate catalog identifies a quiet area on level 2 among Lister Hill Library’s open study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Other library floors are designated quiet floors; use headphones for media and maintain a reasonable volume.

cards.entity_name: Lister Hill Library Second-Floor Conference Room
cards.title: Lister Hill Second-Floor Conference Room
cards.subtitle: Lister Hill Library of the Health Sciences, second floor
cards.notes: Use the space map to check this conference room’s availability, then reserve it for a planned group session that benefits from a dedicated room.
cards.evidence_claim: Lister Hill Library has a conference room space available for booking on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Use this new interactive map feature to book study rooms, seminar rooms and other UAB Libraries spaces
cards.access_notes: Availability and reservation status are shown through the UAB Libraries interactive map and booking tools.
